about_the_game:
Wretched Lead is a tetronimo-strategy tower defense roguelite in it's early development stages, leave a wishlist if you've enjoyed it :)

The Features

SPATIAL PUZZLING

Neatly pack tetronimo-shapes next to each other and fill out the available space to maximise their efficiency. Rearrange your city to adjust your strategy, and rebuild your defenses after taking damage from a wave.

STRATEGIC PLANNING

Explore and exploit a mine to gather resources and buy new buildings from a random selection. Manage the shop’s pool of buildings by locking them in place or banishing a building for the entire run.

ROGUELITE PROGRESSION

Choose the next wave you fight. Take higher risks to receive more medals of honor, which can be spent after a run to unlock new blocks, abilities and game modes.

The Mechanics

SHOP

The shop refreshes at the beginning of each day, generating a random selection of three buildings.

The Shop can be rerolled to refresh its selection.

Shop items can be locked to be unaffected by refreshes or banished to stop them from reappearing.

Spend ores to buy buildings, and drag and rotate them into place.

BASE BUILDING

Buildings can be moved around freely, and put away into a stash for later use.

Turrets shoot enemies in their range

Ability Blocks apply an effect to adjacent turrets periodically

Miners collect ores for each tile they are placed on at the start of each day

Districts expand the city above ground, can apply passive effects

Ore Patches expand the mine underground and reveal new resources

COMBAT

After ending the day, hordes of enemies approach from all sides.

Enemies walk towards the core of your base and attack the closest building. Buildings repair themselves at the end of the night, even when fully destroyed.

Activate the abilities of your commander to take control of a tower and boost it's fire rate.

The night ends when all enemies are destroyed.

If the core of your base reaches 0 health, the run is lost.

short_description: Build your city with tetronimo-blocks and find the optimal layout to defend yourself against an onslaught of enemies. Explore the underground to gather resources and expand your settlement in all directions. Pack and Plan your city for maximum efficiency to push the frontier of humanity.
